hotels.name: Hope Lake Lodge
hotels.distanceText: Research describes it as Greek Peak's slopeside hotel at the base. The distance to a named lift has not been verified.
hotels.notes: Home of the Cascades Indoor Waterpark (https://www.greekpeak.net/waterpark/). 2026-27 Greek Peak Unlimited passholders get 40% off midweek stays (season-pass perks page). Lodging packages: https://www.greekpeak.net/packages/. Check rates with the resort.

source.note: Search summaries of greekpeak.net (resort description and season-pass perks); ski-in/ski-out not verified

hotels.name: Alta Lodge
hotels.distanceText: In the Town of Alta (Little Cottonwood Canyon, SR-210), on or beside the ski area. The walk to a named lift has not been verified (reference note).
hotels.notes: SR-210 closes for avalanche control, and the Town of Alta can issue interlodge orders that keep everyone indoors. Tier is a Piste positioning judgement, not a price. Check rates with the lodge.
